experimental_method: Brucite-periclase dehydration equilibrium reversals in H2O-NaCl fluid in Pt capsules (internally heated Ar apparatus at 2 and 4.2 kbar, piston-cylinder at 4.2-15 kbar); fluid composition change measured by weight loss on drying of punctured capsules; H2O activity derived thermodynamically.
uncertainties_stated: Pressure +-200 bar piston-cylinder (+-7 bar gas vessels); temperature about +-5 C (4.2 kbar bracket +-5 C stated as error); fluid composition closure under 2 mol percent.
quality_remarks: Authors note possible pressure uncertainty at 4.2 kbar piston-cylinder (about 220 bar high). Cl detected in brucite up to 0.17 wt percent, judged negligible. Water activities are derived, not measured directly.
